main.content:
== Transclusion Structure ==

BITwiki uses MediaWiki's transclusion system to create modular, reusable content components. This approach separates content from presentation and enables consistent organization across the wiki.

=== Modular Content ===

Content is organized into small, focused modules:
'' Each module covers a single topic or concept
'' Modules are self-contained and reusable
'' Modules can be combined to create larger pages
'' Module names follow consistent naming conventions

=== Transclusion Benefits ===

The transclusion approach provides several advantages:
'' Content consistency across multiple pages
'' Easier maintenance and updates
'' Reduced duplication of information
'' Clear separation of content and presentation
'' Improved collaboration on specific topics

=== Implementation Guidelines ===

When creating transcludable content:
= Use clear, descriptive module names =
= Keep modules focused on single topics =
= Include all necessary context within each module =
= Use consistent formatting and structure =
= Document module purpose and usage =

=== Content Organization ===

Transclusion enables flexible content organization:
'' Main pages transclude relevant modules
'' Modules can be transcluded in multiple contexts
'' Navigation templates organize related modules
'' Category systems group related content
'' Semantic properties connect modules dynamically

=== Best Practices ===

Follow these best practices for transclusion:
'' Create modules that are truly reusable
'' Avoid overly specific or context-dependent content
'' Use consistent heading levels within modules
'' Test transclusion in multiple contexts
* Document dependencies between modules

This modular approach allows BITwiki to maintain a clean, organized structure while enabling flexible content presentation.
